Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Economics BS (Wharton School) at University of Pennsylvania

What University of Pennsylvania asks of applicants to Economics BS (Wharton School) for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

US · All University of Pennsylvania courses · Business field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 6 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • SAT or ACT required — all first-year applicants, domestic and international
  • Testing waiver available for applicants who face hardship in meeting the requirement
  • No minimum score
Verified19 Oct 2026Penn: Testing
English language
  • English proficiency test required unless English is your native language or your primary language of instruction for at least three years (high school and/or college) by the time you enrol
  • Accepted tests: TOEFL, IELTS Academic, Duolingo English Test — official scores only, from the testing agency
  • For the 2026–27 cycle, only scores from tests taken on or after April 1, 2025 are accepted

Penn publishes the scores of competitive applicants (e.g. TOEFL 5 on the new scale or 100 on the old scale, IELTS 7, Duolingo 130), not minimum scores, so no score is shown as a requirement.

Verified19 Oct 2026Penn: Testing · Penn: International Application Guidelines · Penn: International Applicants
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

The required documents are the application forms, transcript, recommendations, Penn-specific short answers and SAT/ACT scores; no course-specific admissions test is listed for Wharton, Penn Engineering or the College.

Verified19 Oct 2026Penn: Application Requirements
Subject prerequisites
  • Not used in Altiora’s matching yet — see the note for the official guidance

Official: in applicants to The Wharton School, Penn would like to see strong preparation in mathematics, including calculus. Penn presents this as guidance (“we would like to see”), not a stated requirement; Penn also says it has no explicit course requirements.

Partly verified19 Oct 2026Penn: Academics
A-Level requirements
Grades
Not recorded
Details
Penn names A Levels and the IB among the leaving examinations it expects applicants to be preparing for; if results are not released before the deadlines, the school should send predicted results with the grades. Final results are required before matriculation. Penn states it has no explicit course requirements or minimum test score requirements.
